Class StateTransitionsTransmitters

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.statetransitionstables.StateTransitionsTransmitters
All Implemented Interfaces:
SysMLStateMachine.TransitionsUtility
public class StateTransitionsTransmitters extends Object implements SysMLStateMachine.TransitionsUtility
SysMLinJava utility class for the transmission of state transitions data to a state transitions display. The utility includes two types of data transmitters, i.e.
  • a transmitter of state transition table data that includes current state, triggering event, guard, effect, and next state
  • a transmitter of state transition timing data that includes the from and to states at time of transition
Either or both of the utilities are constructed/initialized and assigned to the SysMLStateMachine's transitionsUtility variable. This assignment is made in the createTransitionsUtility() method of the specialized state machine class. An example of use of one of the two transition utilities follows. 

&#64;Override
protected void createTransitionsUtility()
{
	transitionsUtility = Optional.of(new StateTransitionsTransmitters(Optional.of(new StateTransitionTablesTransmitter(StateTransitionsDisplay.udpPort)), Optional.empty()));
}

  • Field Details

    • stateTransitionTablesTransmitter

      private Optional<StateTransitionTablesTransmitter> stateTransitionTablesTransmitter
      A transmitter of state transition table text to UDP port. For possible display and/or storage of this state machine's state transitions occuring during model execution. The transmitter is enabled by calling the enableStateTransitionStringsTransmission(int udpPort) operation.

    • stateTimingDiagramsTransmitter

      private Optional<TimingDiagramsTransmitter> stateTimingDiagramsTransmitter
      A transmitter of state timing diagrams data to UDP port. For possible display and/or storage of this state machine's state transition timings occuring during model execution. The transmitter is enabled by calling the enableStateTransitionTimingsTransmission(int udpPort) operation.

    • logToConsole

      private boolean logToConsole
      Indication if the strings that represent the state transitions are to be logged to the console. If true, strings are logged to console, otherwise they are not.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops the transmission of state transition tables and/or state timing diagrams data to the applicable displays. Attempts to transmit to either of these displays via the transmitters will fail after this call to stop.
